rules.text: locked=true denies first with exact reason 'locked'
effect='deny' denies next with exact reason 'explicit-deny'
viewer permits read; editor permits read/write; admin permits read/write/delete
effect='allow' succeeds only when role permits action; success reason is 'explicit-allow', otherwise 'role-deny'
without effect, permitted action allows with 'role-default'; otherwise deny with 'role-deny'
